artifacts.summary: 5-phase plan covering the 7 live inventory items plus 3 new findings. Scopes item 5 around a planning-time discovery: claudemd merge sources are manifest-declared via merge_targets, and Rule U's 60-line EXTENSION.md cap is gated on the manifest naming EXTENSION.md as the source, so repointing literature to merge-sources/claudemd.md escapes the cap by construction. Item 8 excised, item 7 reframed as a one-directional template re-sync, item 6 targets corrected to ~114 lines.

memory_candidates.content: Extension claudemd merge sources are declared in manifest.json's top-level `merge_targets.claudemd.source` (NOT `provides`), and generate_claudemd() in lua/neotex/plugins/ai/shared/extensions/merge.lua concatenates each loaded extension's declared source. Every non-core extension defaults to `EXTENSION.md`; only core uses a `merge-sources/` directory. Critically, check-extension-docs.sh's Rule U (60-line EXTENSION.md cap) is manifest-authoritative: check_extension_md_length returns early unless claudemd_source_for(ext) equals literally 'EXTENSION.md'. So when an extension's CLAUDE.md contribution outgrows 60 lines, the correct move is to repoint merge_targets.claudemd.source at a new `merge-sources/claudemd.md` (a superset containing the old EXTENSION.md body plus the new content) and DELETE the now-unread EXTENSION.md -- this takes the extension out of Rule U's scope by construction rather than fighting a budget. The same script's own rationale comment records core/EXTENSION.md and slidev/EXTENSION.md were deleted rather than trimmed for exactly this reason: a non-source EXTENSION.md is dead weight no code path reads. The required-file check is likewise gated on the manifest naming EXTENSION.md, so deletion does not trip it.
